svg.title: White Bands on Yellow
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Two white curving bands on yellow painted-paper ground. The left band forms a closed loop; the right opens beyond the top and right support edges. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-drawings-1954-1962-02-2009/lightbox/works/white-bands-on-yellow-1959-31174; record matthewmarks-white-bands-on-yellow-1959-31174; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
